summary: Two controllers (gas analysis, movement) implement all 81 requirements; 13 items record values or choices the requirements did not settle.

issues.title: Values of the six configuration constants
issues.raw: The requirements fix the types of thr, lv, evadeTime, stuckPeriod, stuckDist and outPeriod but not their values. Chosen: THR = 1.0, LV = 1.0, EVADE_TIME = 1, STUCK_PERIOD = 3, STUCK_DIST = 1.0, OUT_PERIOD = 1. The reals are whole-valued so the model's constants interface (which rounds fractional constants up) matches the Java; STUCK_PERIOD exceeds EVADE_TIME so that both outcomes of AvoidingAgain are reachable; values are small to keep the timed model small.
issues.fix_directive: Replace with the deployment's configured values if known; keep reals whole-valued or record the rounding.

issues.title: Initial values of state variables
issues.raw: Only gs has a stated initial value (empty). Chosen: sts = noGas, ins = 0.0, anl = Front; a = Front, l = front, d0 = d1 = 0.0, evasion clock start = 0. None of these is read before it is assigned on every reachable path except a (used only after a turn sets it).
issues.fix_directive: None needed unless the requirements fix initial values.

issues.title: What it means for a reading to indicate the target chemical
issues.raw: CD-Fn1 says analysis returns noGas if no reading indicates the target chemical, without defining 'indicates' or naming the target. Chosen: a value indicates the target when its chemical equals the target Chem given to GasAnalysisSensor's constructor and its intensity is positive. An empty reading is noGas.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm the criterion (e.g. whether a zero-intensity target value counts).

issues.title: Sensor position to direction mapping; ties; empty readings
issues.raw: CD-DM7/CD-Fn3 say the 1-based position maps to a sensing direction via angle(x) but give no mapping. Chosen: 1 Left, 2 Right, 3 Back, 4 Front, repeating cyclically. Ties for the highest intensity go to the first sensor. Outside the non-empty precondition, intensity returns 0.0 and location returns Front.
issues.fix_directive: Replace angle(x) with the vehicle's actual sensor layout if known.

issues.title: Peak intensity and location range over all chemicals in a reading
issues.raw: CD-Fn2 defines intensity as the maximum over every value of the reading, and CD-Fn3 the location of that maximum, regardless of which chemical each value is for; only analysis refers to the target chemical. Implemented literally, so a stronger non-target value could set ins and anl.
issues.fix_directive: If only target-chemical values should count, restrict intensity and location to them.

issues.title: Two controllers connected by same-named sent and received events
issues.raw: The gas-analysis and movement subsystems are two controllers. The gas-analysis controller sends OutputEvent.Turn/Stop/Resume through GasAnalysisActuator.apply; the movement controller receives InputEvent.Turn/Stop/Resume; the identical names make them shared events. ChemicalDetectorSystem wires the two in Java (it is not a controller).

issues.title: Odometer modelled as a sensor quantity, not an input event
issues.raw: CD-Evt3 is typed 'event' but describes a sampled value. d0 and d1 are sampled inside actions, which the profile can only express as a zero-argument sensor call (OdometerSensor.odometer(), a sensor variable), not as an event trigger.

issues.title: Waiting's during action randomWalk()
issues.raw: The profile has no during actions, so randomWalk() is performed on every transition into Waiting (including the resume self-loop), as for an entry action. The initial transition has no action (CD-MV-Beh1), so the start-up random walk is the VehicleActuator's power-on behaviour (randomWalking = true) rather than a model action.
issues.fix_directive: None, unless the initial random walk must appear in the model.

issues.title: Platform operations and changeDirection as Vehicle actuator methods
issues.raw: move(lv, a), randomWalk(), shortRandomWalk() and changeDirection(l) are commands with parameters and side effects, not computed variables, so they are methods of VehicleActuator called from the controller's actions instead of operation-package classes with compute(). changeDirection's steering rule (left to Right, right to Left, front to Back, at lv) is in VehicleActuator.changeDirection; the model sees a call changeDirection(l).
issues.fix_directive: None, unless the pipeline requires operation-package classes for these.

issues.title: NoGas to Reading guard; Analysis and GasDetected entry actions
issues.raw: CD-GA-Beh3 is unguarded and untriggered. The profile has no form for a single unguarded transition, so it is guarded by sts == noGas, which holds whenever NoGas is reached (its only incoming transition requires it). The entry actions of Analysis (sts = analysis(gs)) and GasDetected (ins = intensity(gs)) are written on their single incoming transitions, as the profile prescribes.
issues.fix_directive: If verification needs the transition unguarded, revisit this guard.

issues.title: Final states as terminal modes
issues.raw: The gas-analysis final state is the terminal mode CONCLUDED, entered by CD-GA-Beh6. Found has no outgoing transition, so CD-MV-Beh9 (Found to final) is realised by Found being terminal rather than by a separate unguarded transition to a final state.

issues.title: Representation of Intensity, Chem and the enumeration literals
issues.raw: Intensity is a real (double); goreq is its ordering. Chem is a record with a natural-number identifier, compared only by equality. Enumeration literals keep the requirements' names (Angle Left/Right/Back/Front, Loc left/right/front, Status noGas/gasD); Angle and Loc literals differ only in case.
issues.fix_directive: If the pipeline needs case-distinct literals, rename the Loc literals.

issues.title: Java wiring: readings during analysis; commands during AvoidingAgain
issues.raw: ChemicalDetectorSystem.cycle gives each controller one step per cycle. A gas reading arriving while the previous one is still being analysed is not processed (the model likewise does not accept gas outside Reading). A command arriving while movement is in AvoidingAgain is delivered after one step that completes the autonomous transition, matching the model where the sender waits.

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile, coverage, profile, transformations, FDR4, Dafny, Isabelle, vacuity) and address any failing phase in the Java.
